sentences.text: Ragulapadu Umapathi, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 28

Author: J. Uma Devi
Bench: J.Uma Devi
 The Hon'Ble Ms.JUSTICE J.Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.413 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/ A-1 and A-2, seeking to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.335 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mydukur,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 273 and 353 r/w 34 of I.P.C.
When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that in batch of Criminal Petitions filed to quash the proceedings registered for the offences under Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act were allowed by this Court vide order dated 27.08.2018, in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The case on hand has also been filed questioning the proceedings in C.C.No.335 of 2019, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 273 and 353 r/w 34 of I.P.C.

Following the order passed in the aforementioned batch of criminal petitions, and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal Petition is partly allowed quashing the proceedings in C.C.No.335 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mydukur, in so far as the offence registered under Section 273 I.P.C.

opennyai_summary.PREAMBLE:
Ragulapadu Umapathi, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 28
January, 2020
Author: J. Uma Devi
Bench: J.Uma Devi
 The Hon'Ble Ms.JUSTICE J.Uma Devi
 Criminal Petition No.413 Of 2020
Order:
This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/ A-1 and A-2, seeking to quash the proceedings in C.C.No.335 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mydukur,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 273 and 353 r/w 34 of I.P.C.
When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is brought to the notice of this Court that in batch of Criminal Petitions filed to quash the proceedings registered for the offences under Indian Penal Code and Food Safety and Standards Act were allowed by this Court vide order dated 27.08.2018, in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The case on hand has also been filed questioning the proceedings in C.C.No.335 of 2019, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 273 and 353 r/w 34 of I.P.C.
Following the order passed in the aforementioned batch of criminal petitions, and for the reasons recorded therein, this Criminal Petition is partly allowed quashing the proceedings in C.C.No.335 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mydukur, in so far as the offence registered under Section 273 I.P.C.
In so far as the offence registered under Section 353 r/w 34 I.P.C as against the petitioners, trial may go on in C.C.No.335 of 2019 on the file of the Court of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Mydukur.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any pending, shall also stand closed in consequence.
